title: Best Friend
hook: 好朋友 Suzy 来家里玩，George 想加入却被赶出去，最后他成了游戏里最重要的病人。

cells.a: She was waiting for her best friend, Suzy Sheep.
cells.cn: 她在等最好的朋友小羊 Suzy。

cells.a: Yes. Peppa loved Suzy, and Suzy loved Peppa.
She said, “Go and play in your bedroom.”
No. She said the game was just for big girls.
cells.cn: 没有。她说这个游戏只有大女孩能玩。

cells.q: What did Peppa pretend to be?
cells.a: She pretended to be a fairy princess.
cells.cn: 她假装自己是仙女公主。

cells.a: She was making chocolate chip cookies.
They played doctors and nurses with George.
cells.cn: 他们拉着 George 玩医生和护士。

cells.a: He had a sore tummy, so he wanted cookies.
cells.cn: 他肚子疼，所以也想吃饼干。
